$doc: Hand-reviewed identity decisions the name+birth key cannot make on its own (issue #96).
One entry per reviewed pair (or larger set): `keys` lists the natural `NAME|birth` keys
exactly as scripts/build_person_index.py forms them, `decision` is `merge` (one human,
fold the fragments into one person) or `distinct` (reviewed, genuinely two people),
and `why` records the evidence. `merge` is applied by scripts/build_person_index.py —
the canonical fragment is the one with the chronologically earliest candidacy, the
others land in people.json's `ak` so old deep links keep resolving. Both decisions are
read back by scripts/find_identity_merge_candidates.py so reviewed pairs stop
resurfacing. A key that matches no person fails the build: fix it here, never ignore it.
